name: Border Ranges National Park
bio: A World Heritage rainforest park of crater escarpment lookouts and waterfalls, toured along the Tweed Range Scenic Drive.

name: Yuraygir National Park
bio: The state's longest stretch of undeveloped coastline, between Yamba and Coffs Harbour, with the 65 km coastal walk.

name: Grafton
bio: The Clarence Valley regional city on the Clarence River, known for its jacaranda-lined avenues.
